mapper.select: SELECT /* getReplyList */ R.REPT_NUMB , R.REPL_NUMB , R.UPER_NUMB , R.USER_NUMB , R.REPL_CNTN , R.DELT_YSNO , R.REGI_DATE , R.UPDT_DATE , U.USER_NICK , F.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH FROM TB_REPLXX R LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM U ON R.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON U.PROF_NUMB = F.FILE_NUMB WHERE R.REPT_NUMB = #{reptNumb} ORDER BY R.REPL_NUMB
